description: This file defines a PHP class 'CustomerSearch' within the Opencart admin extension namespace, responsible for handling customer search reports in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for displaying, saving, listing, and generating report data related to customer search activities.

classes.name: CustomerSearch
classes.description: Controller class for handling customer search reports in the OpenCart admin extension, providing CRUD and report view functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the customer search report form view with necessary data and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves settings related to customer search report configurations, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the main customer search report page with search data and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the customer search report list view with current report data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the customer search report data as a string, based on filter parameters.
